sources: Gregorius Magnus, Moralia in Iob XIX.xxvi-xxvii, PL 76 (Paris, 1857), cols. 129-130, archive.org patrologiaecursu76mign n64 (page image)

text:
Source-assisted reading of Stams, Frg. 141 (F-hhs4), made with PL 76 cols. 129-130 available. A research reader reread every legible line of both faces on the native images (canvas 0 box 900,2180,2900,5050; canvas 1 box 2100,2380,4100,5250); top and bottom lines of each face are cropped and only partly read. Expansions in parentheses; ? = uncertain; [...] = lost at the cut edge; [x] = supplied.
